mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals stronger economic demand, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 6-month window, or 20d forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on future cash flows and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain above 2.5% for the full 5-day horizon, or 5d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens economic demand and labor market conditions, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: improving labor market and economic growth
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises while UNRATE does not, or UNRATE falls while GDPC1 does not, leading to no significant 20d returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion characterized by CPIAUCSL below 2% and FEDFUNDS below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy and low inflation, fostering long-term equity valuation growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with low inflation and low rates
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2% or FEDFUNDS rise above 2% during the 60-day horizon, or 60d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust supply-demand balance, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises while PAYEMS does not, or vice versa, resulting in no significant 20d returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market tightness, reducing labor costs for firms and boosting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not remain below 3.5% for the full 5-day horizon, or 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor demand, lowering wage growth expectations and boosting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth slows or turns negative over the 60-day horizon, or 60d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A post-recession recovery phase marked by GDP growth exceeding 5% and unemployment below 4% signals robust economic expansion, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth does not exceed 5% or UNRATE remains ≥4% during the 20-day horizon, or 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
